findings.title: J440 lead route says "keep them south of y 23.5", which in the R10 records' compass is forward (y > 23.5), into the USB-C zone the same instruction forbids
findings.contradicts: The same instruction: "Route J440's leads aft, over or around the (4, 4) nylon screw head ... take them past the aft edge ... Never run them forward along x = 0: there they would cross the USB-C plug zone" (docs/ORDERING.md 8.4 row "J440 leads (R20-MEC-01)"; docs/R10_VEHICLE_HANDOFF.md "J440 lead routing"). The R10 records use north = smaller KiCad y = aft (y = 0 is the aft edge, ORDERING.md line 7 / 322): D-R26-01 "a GND via 1.5 mm north of each AUX pin, (7.4, 16.5) for J440.3" (pin at y 18.0); D-R26-02 "R173 moves 0.65 mm north, (16.87, 59.7) -> (16.87, 59.05)" and R10_VALIDATION "0.65 mm toward the aft edge (y - 0.65 mm)"; M3_R10 "R173 cannot go back south" (= larger y); ORDERING 8.3 TP122 "brush it last from south/east only" (TP122 y 52.55-54.05 is at larger y than U5, y 47.05-51.15).
findings.evidence: Board a0ec075e (pcbnew): J440 F(7.4,16.25) rot -90, model box x 3.40-11.50, y 7.93-23.45; wire entries at J440.1-.4 y 11.0 / 14.5 / 18.0 / 21.5, all at y < 23.5; support (4,4) at y 4; J3 USB-C shell box x -0.45-7.45, y 26.33-35.27 (fit_check r10 report). "South of y 23.5" in the records' convention is y > 23.5: from J440's west face that means running the leads forward along x = 0 into J3's y 26.3-35.3 zone, away from the (4,4) head and the aft edge, which the same sentence requires and forbids respectively. The intended region (aft of J440's forward body end, toward (4,4) and y = 0) is y < 23.5, i.e. north of y 23.5. Origin: round20_mechanics.md R20-MEC-01 fix text, copied into both documents.
findings.impact: A harness builder following the stated bound literally routes the AUX/GPS/radio leads forward past J3 and toward the J121 / J400 exits and the (4,44.3) head: the chafe/fire-class adjacency (J440.1 / .2 onto J121.1, J440.1 / .3 onto J400.2) the row exists to prevent. The row is self-contradictory as written.
findings.concrete_fix: In docs/ORDERING.md 8.4 "J440 leads" row and docs/R10_VEHICLE_HANDOFF.md "J440 lead routing", replace "keep them south of y 23.5" with "keep them aft of y 23.5 (y < 23.5, J440's forward body end at y 23.45)"; same wording in any future copy of R20-MEC-01.

observations: Plate model re-run on a0ec075e (fit report from tools/fit_check.py --profile r10, masses.json): f1 180.8 / 255.6 / 287.8 / 407.0 Hz (pinned D5 / D10, clamped D5 / D10), 78.6 g, max 100 g deflection 1.27 mm at (46, 44.5); 100 g gap at h = 4 mm: C431 0.261 mm, C421 0.320 mm, L1 0.524 mm, C411 0.558 mm; at h = 3.5 mm C431 -0.239 / C421 -0.180 mm (overlap). The recorded 180.8 Hz / 78.6 g / 0.261 / 0.320 mm and the 125 / 133 / 175 / 214 g contact loads hold on a0ec075e; the docs' "not re-run on a0ec075e" is now stale but not false.

M3_R10 "Historical mechanical record" keeps the R10-MEC-01 C10 coat clearance 3.333144 / 3.777017 mm; on a0ec075e it is 3.016596 / 3.449036 mm (my pcbnew measurement), which ORDERING 8.3 and AVA_LAYOUT state correctly. It is under a heading that declares the section historical, so not counted.

M3_R10 "Historical mechanical record" mixes current guidance (sled plate h + t bounds, verified 6.0184 / 5.3653 mm) with GH-era figures; the heading is misleading but each historical figure is labelled with its board.

M3_R10 / East-edge asymmetry quotes the 632a9ad3 strains and 1.24 mm deflection, labelled as such. On a0ec075e: J410 1421, J420 1414, J9 1313, C431 1221, J400 1157, J440 1184, C411 1303, C421 1117, R150-R155 1336-1420 microstrain; 1.27 mm. Labelled older figures, not false.

tools/test_r10_plate.py fails (1 error): its fixture lacks J430 / J440 rows that plate_model.build now requires (D-R19-14). check.sh does not run it (only test_r10_check Plate), and the plate model is optional, so no rule is violated; the stale self-test could be fixed or deleted.

J440 GND partner vias (7.4,16.5) / (7.4,20.0): 0.5 / 0.3 mm, tented on F and B (no openings in m3-F_Mask / m3-B_Mask; drilled in m3-PTH.drl), under J440's body (x 3.40-11.50, y 7.93-23.45), clear of the pin tail AABBs (0.30 mm), of the (4,4) support (> 12 mm) and of the bore. No mechanical or JLC rule is violated.

fit_check --profile r10 on a0ec075e: OK, 235 rows; worst margin J3 0.886 mm, DB125 bodies 2.976 mm, D402 / D440 / D441 5.597 mm; 27 tails min 7.558 mm, 2.20 mm projection, 1.80 mm to a 4 mm plate; L1 3.016 mm below the bottom face; nearest bottom C32.2 4.536 mm and top LED2.2 3.808 mm from (4,44.3); LED1.1 3.860, J2.1 3.880, J2.3 3.987 mm; J440 body 3.930 mm from (4,4); wire room 5.003-5.603 mm at all eight terminals. All match the records.

fix_verification.measurement: GND vias at (7.4,16.5) and (7.4,20.0), 1.500 mm from J440.3 / J440.4 centres; 0.300 mm copper to own pin pad, 0.800 mm to the neighbouring pin, 0.700 mm hole to hole, 0.600 mm via ring to pin hole; tented both sides in the bound Gerbers; no fit, support or tail conflict.

Placement diff 92c3ad59 -> a0ec075e: only C10 (54.1 -> 53.5), C11 (52.1 -> 51.45), R164 (55.9 -> 55.25), R173 (59.7 -> 59.05) moved, all bottom; no terminal, support or outline change; fit, support clearances and plate figures unchanged; C10 coat clearance 3.016596 mm (pads 3.449036 mm) to the U5 union, as ORDERING 8.3 states.
